reviews.text: One of the best places in Porto for veterinary care and grooming. Super caring and personalized service for each breed of dog or cat. My Pomeranian always looks AMAZING. Very professional, knowledgeable about the specific needs of each breed, and attentive. TOP service.

Everything was perfect! The service was super attentive, with lots of care and affection for the animals and their owners. And of course, the result was impeccable.

The photo shows the professionalism and dedication of the team.

We were really satisfied and highly recommend them!
Amazing facility for my pop to get bathes, hotel/boarding, vet services. Love them and their personalized attention
Very expensive, cut and bath for a small Yorkshire 2,5 kg : 50 € !
Arrogant owner. Doesn't understand anything about dogs, only uses aversive methods.

The owner mistreats the employees in front of customers and likes to act like he knows everything when he knows nothing.
Poor team in the hands of these gentlemen.

DISAPPOINTING.

The staff and medical team were very friendly and attentive, but the experience with the owner (Paulo Bento) was extremely negative. He displayed an arrogant and unpleasant attitude from the start, thinking he knows everything about dogs, but what we witnessed was completely unprofessional. He picked up our bullmastiff (a large, strong dog weighing almost 80kg) with such force that our dog whimpered in pain, which was completely unacceptable. This was all because he thought he could forcefully apply a drop to his eye, but the truth is he remained in that consultation room for 15 minutes straight and couldn't apply A SINGLE DROP.

Furthermore, he made tasteless comments about the cost of our dog's treatment, which left us extremely uncomfortable and speechless. Disrespectful and totally inappropriate jokes, especially in front of the staff.

Unfortunately, we will not return and cannot recommend this establishment. The treatment of animals and respect for customers should be a priority, and this clearly did NOT happen here with the OWNER of the establishment. A SHAME!
Good pet shop in Porto. Friendly staff with pet owners and attentive to the animals. Wide range of products for sale. And Dr. Marta (veterinarian) is a real asset.

Terrible grooming experience with my dog. They made a mistake during the grooming, leaving my dog's head shorter in the center and longer on the sides. When I took her to another groomer, I showed photos to the groomer, who wouldn't admit it. He said I had already brought my dog ​​in like that and that it was a matter of opinion. He insisted that I had brought my dog ​​in with the hair shorter in the middle of her head. Besides doing a bad job during the grooming, they also disrespect the customer when they don't admit it. They don't accept being shown the flaws. They think they are the best. They are not. I definitely do not recommend them! I'm posting a before and after photo so you can form your own opinion.

Excellent service!
They are so kind to our animals and always available for us!

We wouldn't trade them for anything! Total dedication!
Thank you very much, Maria Cristina!

Good afternoon! I've been a customer of your establishment, along with my bathing partners, for 9 years and have always been satisfied with the service. I don't understand how it's possible to call twice to schedule a bath and hear, twice, …
